caption: The drawing depicts a geometric pattern composed primarily of cubes, diamonds, and triangles, resembling a quilt design. The central area consists of three interlocked blue and white cubes, with the white faces decorated with small, multicolored floral or foliage motifs. These cubes are surrounded by red, triangular shapes that form a star-like configuration, with each triangle outlined and shaded to highlight a quilted texture. Around the edges, there are additional cubes rendered in various shades: some are shaded brown and tan, others in blue, and some in light gray, adorned with hatched or patterned designs such as stripes and dots. The entire pattern is set against an off-white or beige background, and the piece is signed with text at the bottom right corner. The arrangement is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with a careful alignment of colors and patterns within the geometric framework.
title: Quilt Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
